plan.summary:
This change adds a cache check to the health run and makes the probe send a real HTTP request with a two-second timeout. The probe now reports the HTTP status code.

- `run_checks()` now includes `check_cache()`.
- `probe(url)` calls `httpx.get(url, timeout=2.0)`.
- The probe result now has a `status` field.
plan.riskRationale: The change is small. It touches health and probe code only. The new HTTP call can raise errors on timeout, and the source excerpts show no handling for that.
plan.storyArc: The PR first changes the probe so that slow endpoints stop after two seconds. It then adds the cache check to the health run.

topics.title: Probe uses a two-second HTTP timeout
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `probe` now behave for slow or failing endpoints? Connect the `httpx` import to the new `httpx.get(..., timeout=2.0)` call and the added `status` field. Verify whether timeout exceptions are handled by callers.

topics.title: Health run includes the cache check
topics.narrativeBrief: What does `run_checks` now run? Connect the new `check_cache` import to its use in the returned list. Verify that `check_cache` exists in `service.checks`.
